title: Low hydraulic pressure
description: Measured working pressure remains below target for the commanded operation.
safety_notes: Lower suspended loads before pressure testing.

title: Hydraulic pressure instability
description: Pressure oscillates under steady command input.
safety_notes: Avoid high-speed cycling until instability is isolated.

title: Reduced cooling efficiency
description: Oil cooler delta temperature is below expected range.
safety_notes: Allow oil to cool before opening hydraulic lines.

title: Pump degradation suspected
description: Pump flow drops while drive speed remains stable.
safety_notes: Do not continue production at elevated temperature.

title: Accumulator pressure issue
description: Accumulator precharge or operating pressure is outside safe limits.
safety_notes: Depressurize and follow accumulator lockout procedure.

title: Flow restriction
description: Flow rate is lower than expected for valve command and pump speed.
safety_notes: Watch for sudden movement after clearing a restriction.

title: Oil temperature above threshold
description: Hydraulic oil temperature exceeds operating limit.
safety_notes: Use heat-resistant PPE around reservoir and cooler.

title: Abnormal vibration
description: Vibration RMS exceeds baseline for the hydraulic power unit.
safety_notes: Do not stand in coupling guard plane during testing.

title: Sensor mismatch
description: Redundant or related sensors report inconsistent values.
safety_notes: Use mechanical gauges for safety-critical confirmation.

title: Voltage drop
description: Control voltage drops below acceptable range during actuation.
safety_notes: Unexpected valve dropout may cause load movement.

title: Return filter restriction
description: Return filter differential pressure is elevated.
safety_notes: Contain spilled oil during filter change.

title: Pump cavitation signature
description: Noise and vibration pattern indicates inlet starvation.
safety_notes: Stop test if pump noise escalates rapidly.

title: Directional valve sticking
description: Valve response lags or fails to return to neutral.
safety_notes: Block moving components before valve work.

title: Cylinder drift
description: Cylinder position changes without command under load.
safety_notes: Support loads mechanically before isolation tests.

title: Oil contamination suspected
description: Particle count or filter trend suggests oil contamination.
safety_notes: Dispose of contaminated media per site procedure.

title: External hydraulic leakage
description: Visible oil leakage or reservoir level loss detected.
safety_notes: Never use hands to locate high-pressure leaks.

title: Hose abrasion risk
description: Hose cover damage or contact point found near moving structure.
safety_notes: Replace exposed reinforcement before return to service.

title: Relief valve opening early
description: Relief valve begins bypassing below specified set pressure.
safety_notes: Use calibrated test equipment and pressure-rated hoses.

title: Air entrainment
description: Foaming, erratic pressure, or spongy actuator response detected.
safety_notes: Allow foam to dissipate before high-load operation.

title: Bearing wear signature
description: Vibration spectrum shows likely bearing defect in pump or motor.
safety_notes: Lock out rotating equipment before inspection.
